context: A police officer briefs on financial-fraud risks
purpose: Teach: （株）/小生/亭/竹中/ニッポン放送/世田谷/キャピタル/人組

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 御社（株）の金融取引、警察庁ガイドラインに準拠してください。
lines.en: Your company's financial transactions need to comply with National Police Agency guidelines.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Speaking from procedure, not judgment. Clear enunciation on compliance terms. Slight pause between clauses—giving weight without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。小生が、対応窓口です。
lines.style: Direct and ready. Quick acknowledgment—no elaboration. Solid, steady delivery. Eye contact steady. Taking responsibility without making a show of it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 過去事例、九段亭での会食を悪用した詐欺、参考にしてください。
lines.en: Look at the past cases—fraud schemes using Kudan-tei dinners as cover. They're instructive.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Specific weight on 「過去事例」. Speaking as someone who has seen patterns repeat. Slight deliberate pace, giving each reference time to land.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 竹中先生にも、ニッポン放送経由で警鐘を頂きました。
lines.en: MP Takenaka passed along a similar warning to us through Nippon-Hoso.
lines.style: Factual update, no urgency. Calm acknowledgment that the alert came from above. Light conversational tone—just adding context he was meant to know.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 世田谷オフィスの監視カメラ、キャピタル取引にも対応する2人組体制で。
lines.en: The Setagaya office surveillance system—set up a two-person rotation specifically for capital transactions.
lines.style: Directive closing. Crisp, clear instructions. Speaking with authority but not harshness. Pause before the practical detail. The tone of someone closing a briefing.
